svg.title: Annual CO2 growth rate 2015-2025 from OCO-2 and NOAA
svg.desc: Bar chart of annual CO₂ growth from OCO-2 for 2015 to 2025, with NOAA surface-network values as open circles that mostly fall within a few tenths of the bars; 2024 is highest at 3.47 ppm per year and 2025 drops to 1.96. Shaded spans mark El Niño periods, which line up with the high-growth years 2015–16 and 2023–24.
